brief:
Israeli forces escalated violations of the Gaza ceasefire on Friday morning, Shehab Wire reported, conducting intensive artillery and gunfire operations across multiple scattered locations throughout the enclave. The military offensive accompanied limited ground advances by armored vehicles and included systematic demolition of residential buildings in affected areas.

The escalation marked a continuation of repeated breaches undermining the truce agreement. Israeli occupation forces have maintained operations despite the ceasefire arrangement, conducting strikes and ground movements that have drawn concerns about the stability of the agreement in Gaza.
